embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: MVAgent: Multi-Agent Video Generation via Consistent Condition Construction and Shot-Level Policy Optimization
fields.value: Alibaba Group — MVAgent is a multi-agent pipeline for generating multi-shot videos that keep characters, spatial layout, and camera angles consistent across shots, built on top of a frozen video generator.

fields.name: From Scattered Gaussians to Structured Maps: Efficient Gaussian Splatting Coding via Dual-phase Morton Sorting
fields.value: Alibaba — The paper addresses the storage and bandwidth cost of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), whose unstructured millions-of-primitives representation resists standard video-codec compression.

fields.name: Unity Insight: A Production Code–Asset Index for LLM Coding Agents in Unity Projects
fields.value: Unity — The paper presents Unity Insight, a persistent, read-only code–asset index built to let LLM coding agents navigate Unity game-engine repositories, where gameplay logic spans C# scripts, prefabs, scenes, and ScriptableObjects linked by GUIDs and YAML serialization.

fields.name: The Past Frames the Future: Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation
fields.value: NVIDIA — This is a survey/framework paper (not an empirical model paper) organizing how autoregressive video generators maintain memory of past frames — entity identities, spatial layout, dynamics — under bounded context windows, covering discrete-token, diffusion, flow, and Transformer-based generators, inc

fields.name: M-plicits: Neural Implicit Surfaces via Nested Multiscale Residuals
fields.value: Google — The paper targets a tradeoff in neural implicit surface representations for 3D reconstruction from point clouds: single-MLP methods are accurate but slow at inference, while grid-based methods are fast but can overfit noise and limit surface smoothness.

fields.name: Latent evolving World Action Model
fields.value: Baidu Inc. — The paper introduces LeWAM, a World Action Model that replaces large video-diffusion backbones with JEPA-derived predictive embeddings for robot action generation, arguing these support action generation better than compressed VAE latents.

fields.name: Heartian: Physiology-Aware Relightable Gaussian Head Avatar
fields.value: Adobe — Heartian addresses the fact that conventional Gaussian head avatars treat facial appearance as temporally static, ignoring the subtle cardiac-induced skin-color changes (remote photoplethysmography, or rPPG) that a real face exhibits.

fields.name: GameDirector: Decoupling Gameplay Logic from Rendering for Player-Configurable Game World Models
fields.value: Tencent — GameDirector is presented as "the first agentic framework that decouples rule-based gameplay logic from visual rendering" in game world models.

fields.name: Code Plans, Diffusion Renders: Open-Ended Generative World Modeling
fields.value: Alibaba — CoDeR is a world-modeling system that explicitly constructs an executable world using code, then uses a video generation model for visual realization, rather than implicitly encoding dynamics purely in a video model's weights.

fields.name: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
fields.value: Tencent; other authors are Peking University — WorldCrafter is a video world model that maintains long-horizon and multi-view consistency using an implicit, camera-queryable 3D-aware memory.

fields.name: SAM-V: Geometry-Aware Segment Anything for Multi-View Instance Segmentation
fields.value: Meta; primary team is University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign) (flag) — SAM-V integrates a feed-forward geometry model (VGGT) into the Segment Anything (SAM) foundation model, training the combination end-to-end for consistent object segmentation across multiple camera views in a single forward pass.

fields.name: GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay
fields.value: Tencent; other affiliations include Great Bay University, University of Macau, National University of Singapore, HUST, MMLab CUHK — GameHorizon Suite is an evaluation framework for AI game-playing models spanning multiple task horizons.

fields.name: GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation
fields.value: Tencent — GAE (Geometry-Native Autoencoder) is a latent representation for video/scene generation that is decodable to appearance, depth, cameras, and point maps, aiming to give generative models a geometry-aware latent space instead of a purely appearance-focused one.

fields.name: VGGT-Prime: Compute-Adaptive Mixture-of-Heads for Efficient Visual Geometry Transformers
fields.value: Huawei Noah's Ark Lab (flag) — VGGT-Prime is a compute-adaptive variant of the Visual Geometry Transformer (VGGT) that speeds up multi-view 3D reconstruction (camera pose, depth, point clouds) by exploiting redundancy across attention heads rather than tokens.

fields.name: Mira-Scene: Pixel-Aligned Layouts for Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction
fields.value: VAST; per-author numeric mapping not resolved from the rendered HTML) (flag) — Mira-Scene reconstructs compositional 3D scenes from a single image by replacing sparse object-pose regression with dense, pixel-aligned correspondence recovery via a "Canonical Coordinate Map." fields.name: UltraTex: Unleashing 2K Multi-View Diffusion for 3D Texturing
fields.value: VAST, Beijing; other authors are Jilin University, University of Hong Kong, Tongji University, Fudan University, Shanghai Innovation Institute) (flag) — UltraTex is an efficient multi-view diffusion framework for generating high-quality 3D object textures at 2K (2048) resolution.
